title: Wildwood Speedway

facts.statement: The kart race event was held at the Bois Sauvage circuit (Wildwood Speedway in the client), south of the Crossroads teleport stone.
facts.quote: Rendez-vous ce jeudi et vendredi, sur le Circuit du Bois Sauvage, sud de la Pierre de téléportation du Carrefour

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news/event notice announcing a kart race event at the Wildwood (French: Bois Sauvage) Speedway, held on two dates in March 2011 on Server 1 for different regions, hosted by Free Realms ambassadors. The page gives the race schedule and a helmet reminder; it says nothing about rewards or race rules. The date 2011-03-10 is inferred from the first event date given in the text; the page header itself shows only a relative 'posted 2 months, 3 weeks ago' age.
